props.text: We make a small range of clothing and homeware in natural materials, produced in small batches.
Linen, wool and ceramics in small batches. Free delivery over $80 and repairs for life.
The standard we hold ourselves to
Free delivery on orders over $80, easy returns within thirty days, and a repair service for anything we sell.
“The best linen shirt I own. Two years and still perfect.”
“They repaired my jacket for free. Who does that?”

props.question: How long does delivery take?
props.answer: Two to four working days in the city, up to a week elsewhere.

props.question: Can I return an item?
props.answer: Yes, within thirty days, unworn and with its tags.

props.question: How do repairs work?
props.answer: Send it back with a note. We repair it and post it home free of charge.

props.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
props.answer: Cards, mobile money and bank transfer.
